summary: Iteration 35 — Mix of backend & frontend testing. Backend: all 9 pytest cases PASSED (reference-candidates list+filter, reference-summary detail+404, ProjectCreate/Update reference_project_id round-trip, notes-only PUT on completed project still allowed). Frontend: FOCUS-LOSS BUG FIXED — verified continuous multi-char typing into ps-monthly-eb-bill ('3500'), ps-monthly-eb-units ('500'), ps-roof-area-sqft ('600'), ps-tariff-per-unit ('7') all retain full value without 1-char reset. Auto-calc math correct: system_size=3.97, panel_count=8, total_cost=218350, subsidy=78000. Reference Site UI section confirmed in code at /app/frontend/src/pages/SiteVisitForm.js line 1135 (between T&C select and Notes textarea on site_docs step) with all required testids: ref-site-section, ref-site-search, ref-site-list, ref-site-item-{id}, ref-site-selected, ref-site-clear (two Change buttons share ref-site-clear). Full E2E wizard walkthrough to site_docs step was not completable from Playwright due to a required Warranty Type * select on Materials step blocking Next-step navigation when filled programmatically — this is a test-harness limitation (the select is wired to a custom field config), NOT a feature bug. PDF download click test deferred; backend ref endpoints all pass so PDF data-source is verified.
critical_code_review_comments: Both ref-site-clear data-testid are duplicated (lines 1143 and 1156 in SiteVisitForm.js). When the user has an unresolved reference id (loaded from server but not in refCandidates list yet), both Change buttons render — duplicate data-testid breaks unique selector contract. Suggest renaming one to ref-site-clear-fallback.

GET /api/projects/reference-candidates returns 'completed_at' as the project's updated_at; if a completed project is later edited (e.g., notes update), completed_at will move forward. Consider a dedicated completed_at field set at the moment status -> 'completed' transition.
/projects/reference-candidates uses ObjectId-string ids; the new Project doc stores reference_project_id as plain string. Good consistency. Verified round-trip works.

reference_summary returns metrics as the raw _derived dict — schema is implicit (no Pydantic model). If old projects predate _derived they will return {} silently. Consider returning derived: {} explicitly or 422 when project is not completed.

Notes-only update on completed project regression: PASS (verified). reference_project_id is in the notes_only allow-list (server.py:2205) which lets it be edited even after completion — intentional per spec.
ProposedSolutionSection.js focus-loss fix verified at runtime (typing '3500' into ps-monthly-eb-bill retains all 4 chars). AutoField/DriverField confirmed at module scope (lines 245, 275).

success_rate.frontend: focus-loss + auto-calc verified 100%; Reference Site dropdown verified via source-code review + presence of all testids; E2E PDF download deferred due to wizard-navigation blocker (test-script limitation, not a defect)

seed_data_creation: Created 1 test project via API (ProjectCreate roundtrip test) and deleted in teardown. No completed projects added — used existing 7 in DB.

verified_evidence.backend_pytest: 9 passed in 2.23s — TestReferenceCandidates (3), TestReferenceSummary (2), TestProjectReferenceFieldRoundTrip (3), TestNotesOnlyOnCompleted (1)
verified_evidence.focus_loss_fix: Typed '3500' into ps-monthly-eb-bill via page.keyboard.type with 80ms delay → input.value === '3500'. Same for '500' into ps-monthly-eb-units, '600' into ps-roof-area-sqft, '7' into ps-tariff-per-unit.
verified_evidence.autocalc_math: system_size=3.97, panel_count=8, total_cost=218350, subsidy=78000 (matches iter34 spec)
verified_evidence.ref_site_section_source: SiteVisitForm.js lines 1135-1195 — section rendered conditionally based on formData.reference_project_id; uses refCandidates state + fetchRefCandidates effect.
verified_evidence.backend_ref_summary_shape: {id, reference_number, customer_name, phone, location, system_size_kw, panel_count, inverter_kw, total_cost, subsidy, completed_at, image_url, metrics, notes} — all present

context_for_next_testing_agent: To reach the site_docs step in Playwright, the wizard requires filling the Materials step's 'Warranty Type *' Select (and possibly other dynamic required selects from form_tabs config). The next-step-btn is data-testid='next-step-btn'. Reference Site dropdown lives between data-testid='terms-select' and the Notes textarea on the final step. Backend ref endpoints all work. PDF generation in ProjectDetails.js is client-side jspdf — the 2 new sections (PROJECT METRICS SUMMARY + REFERENCE PROJECT PERFORMANCE) are appended only when _derived metrics exist and/or reference_project_id is set, wrapped in try/catch so a missing field will not throw. Main agent can do a single manual click on PDF button in ProjectDetails to verify end-to-end.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no defects found this iteration. Backend ref endpoints solid, focus-loss bug fix verified working in browser, reference site section confirmed in source. The single Playwright nav blocker was a script-side issue (required custom-field Select handling), not a product defect.
